mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, survey_id, condition_type, condition_code, sort_order, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sol_site_survey_condition WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND survey_id = #{query.surveyId} AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sol_site_survey_condition WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND survey_id = #{query.surveyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sol_site_survey_condition (id, tenant_id, survey_id, condition_type, condition_code, sort_order, creator, updater) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.surveyId}, #{row.conditionType}, #{row.conditionCode}, #{row.sortOrder}, #{row.creator}, #{row.updater})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, survey_id, device_id, project_id, sn, product_code, product_name, product_model, reason, sort_order, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sol_site_survey_material WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND survey_id = #{query.surveyId} AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sol_site_survey_material WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND survey_id = #{query.surveyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sol_site_survey_material (id, tenant_id, survey_id, device_id, project_id, sn, product_code, product_name, product_model, reason, sort_order, creator, updater, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.surveyId}, #{row.deviceId}, #{row.projectId}, #{row.sn}, #{row.productCode}, #{row.productName}, #{row.productModel}, #{row.reason}, #{row.sortOrder}, #{row.creator}, #{row.updater}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
